package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in the report. The article discusses social engineering attempts to gain maintainer access to popular JavaScript projects, referencing the XZ Utils backdoor as a similar incident, but does not provide details of any actual malicious code or package.

behavioral_signatures: Unsolicited requests for maintainer or contributor access to popular open source projects
Emails or messages urging urgent updates for critical vulnerabilities from unknown or new contributors
Attempts to gain elevated permissions in project repositories
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unusual or unsolicited requests to become a maintainer or contributor, especially those referencing urgent security updates. Review contributor history and verify identities before granting elevated permissions. Implement multi-factor authentication and require multiple trusted maintainers to approve changes to critical project infrastructure.
